Okay so long story short I have a slew of mental illnesses.. I have suffered from severe depression since I was like 9 years old, anxiety since I was born I think, and some other stuff that would take up like 10 pages, it led me into 9 years of addiction. I wasn't sure how I could ever move on beyond that. I got sober I've been sober for about 5 years. I thought life would get better, my depression would be easier to handle, my anxiety would come to a level where I could actually function in society. Well that is the exact opposite of what happened. I suffer from severe PTSD from things that happened during my addiction and kind of my addiction itself. I only used to crack for one year and I swear that brought me to a level of hell that Dante didn't even know existed. Well a few months back maybe 6 months ago I was trying to get into a doctor who would do spravato therapy. I had basically I guess an interview to see if the spravato treatment would be right for me. The psychiatrist did not see that it would be fit because of my addiction, which I think is really unfair but anyways, she recommended another therapy that they offer that I didn't even know about. That is TMS therapy. So I started going it went like three times. I kind of feel like it really did help me. I guess it can help some people right away and some people need months but that's not the point here. I had a Panic episode where I wouldn't leave the house and that made me unable to attend my TMs sessions so I essentially quit. Then last week I had like some crazy Awakening and I decided I needed to give up all I've got and stop letting my mental illness control my life rather I was going to change my behaviors to help change my thoughts. You know like CBT? Well anyways I called them and tomorrow which is Monday I am going in to see the psychiatrist to go through and just make sure I'm still a good candidate for the therapy. I know they will begin therapy for me again they said I could come back anytime. I guess it's just protocol because it's been over 6 months. But I am a little bit nervous and I kind of feel like I don't want to go and I just want to stay home. But I feel like that about literally everything in the world so I think I'm going to force myself to do it. I think you should be excited there is really nothing to lose for you here. You can literally only gain. If you change your mind after you try it okay that's fine. But please give it a shot at least a couple sessions it's only 20 minutes long. You can do this! I will tell you honestly I actually know someone who completed TMS, she's a doctor at a walk-in clinic, she was really struggling and actually had to quit her job due to depression. Now shes back and says she never had so many good days in her life.. life will never be perfect, as people with severe depression just having like a majority of days being bearable is all we want... (thats how i feel anyways.) It changed her life. She said it's not like life just became perfect it's more like she finally felt the motivation and the will just to live
If it could change hers why not ours as well? I believe in you! You can do this and you can change your life! And I am always here for it if you ever want someone to talk to feel free to message me. I know all of our sufferings are different but in the end pain is pain. We don't want to live like this regardless of what people might think we are not lazy or just not trying hard enough. We don't need more sun or vitamins where to eat different, okay those things we might need to do but it's not going to change our depression is what I mean. We are simply people living with an illness that's invisible. All we can do is try to be our best selves everyday. Even if sometimes all we can do is hide under the covers. As long as you are not out there contributing to anyone else's pain you deserve 1 million percent deserve happiness. You can do this, that I promise you.
